limits: One initialization/training order; bootstrap is over words, not training seeds.
Confidence intervals do not adjust for selection or testing two learning rates.
Most words have one distinct positive probe context; no broad lexical-generalization claim.
A mean contextual shift exceeding x* is not proof of 5% repaired sentence decisions.

interpretation: Acquisition diagnostic only. Positive early gain earns consideration of a separate chase; it is not evidence of forgetting or a new method.
